==Where Ogier live?==
Aren't these groves just trees that were planted in places the Ogier worked?  I think it is incorrect to say that the groves are "places where Ogier live", as they almost all live in the stedding, and IIRC groves can be far from stedding...

Perhaps you could just say groves were planted in places where Ogier worked? (there may be other groves in other places too, I don't know about that)--[[User:Gherald|Gherald]] 20:42, 22 September 2006 (UTC)
:They seem to live ''under'' the Great Trees, almost like 10-foot-tall [[wikipedia:hobbit|hobbits]]... -- ''[[User:Nae'blis|nae]]'[[User_talk:Nae'blis|blis]]'' 22:11, 23 September 2006 (UTC)

==After the Breaking???==

I suspect that by default, this claim is true.  All Ogier groves currently in existence were planted after the Breaking of the World, but the first line or this article implies that Ogier never planted groves prior to the Breaking.  Is there any reason to believe this?
:Don't forget to sign you posts (<nowiki>~~~~</nowiki>).  But the answer to your question is Yes.  Ogier did not suffer from the longing prior to the breaking of the world, and the primary reason to plant the goves was to remind them of the stedding and hold off the longing. This doesn't prove that they didn't, but it is a reason to believe they may not have, atleast not in the same way they did after the breaking. Also durring the Age of Legends humans planted many more trees in thier cities and brought Ogier out to sing the songs of growth (harvest?) with the [[Nym]].
